## 🇨🇭 Best Swiss Longevity Supplement Brands

---

### 1. 🥇 **Timeline (Amazentis) — Lausanne**
**Website:** [timeline.com](https://www.timeline.com)

The gold standard in Swiss longevity science. 
Timeline (parent company Amazentis) is a pioneering Swiss health science company committed to revolutionizing the longevity industry with its groundbreaking, clinically proven, proprietary ingredient Mitopure®.
 
Timeline was founded at — and remains headquartered at — the EPFL (École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne), Swiss Federal Institute of Technology, one of the world's leading research institutions in life sciences and biotechnology.


Their hero ingredient, Mitopure® (Urolithin A), is uniquely powerful: 
it is the only clinically tested, FDA GRAS, and NSF Certified Urolithin A ingredient available today.
 
Timeline announced major scientific milestones reinforcing its position as a leader in clinically researched longevity supplements, targeting three critical unmet needs of healthy aging: muscle, immune, and brain function, and expanding its foundational clinical science on muscle health with a new clinical study on immune aging and a new clinical study for brain health.
 
Timeline has raised CHF 56 million in an oversubscribed Series D financing round that included strategic investments by L'Oréal and Nestlé.


---

### 2. 🥈 **AVEA Life — Zug**
**Website:** [avea-life.com](https://aveva-life.com)

The most consumer-popular Swiss longevity brand. 
AVEA® is a registered trademark of AVEA Life AG, a Switzerland-based longevity startup founded in 2021 in Zug, with a founding team that came together around a shared commitment: to enable everyday people to access clean, high-quality supplements with transparent ingredients based on the latest scientific insights in the rapidly growing field of longevity.



Working with an interdisciplinary team of scientists and researchers from institutions like ETH Zürich, they launched their first product, AVEA® NMN, in 2022.
 
The AVEA® Collagen Activator is built around Colgevity™, a unique amino acid blend developed in cooperation with ETH Zurich and patented by AVEA® in 2025 — a vegan collagen precursor shown to be 4x more effective than conventional collagen supplements.
 
Today, AVEA® is trusted by over 100,000 customers and holds a 4.8/5 rating on Trustpilot.
 
Products are manufactured in GMP-certified facilities in Switzerland regularly audited by authorities, and each batch is sent to an independent Swiss laboratory for additional purity testing.


---

### 3. 🥉 **Clinique La Prairie — Montreux (Holistic Health Line)**
**Website:** [cliniquelaprairie.com](https://www.cliniquelaprairie.com/longevity-supplements/)

The most prestigious and heritage-rich Swiss brand. 
Clinique La Prairie offers ultimate longevity supplements backed by over 90 years of expertise.
 
Holistic Health is the industry's most sophisticated supplement range based on years of research and innovation, fully made in Switzerland.



The CLP Holistic Complex is the core ingredient of Clinique La Prairie's range of Swiss-made nutritional supplements; it targets the five pillars of Holistic Wellness at a cellular level through five potent bioactives including Synerithin (immune-protection) and others.
 
Their flagship AGE-DEFY supplement offers a 2-step routine combining Regeneressence and Immunity to address cell regeneration, anti-inflammation, and antioxidant protection.
 Expect premium pricing befitting one of Switzerland's most storied wellness institutions.

---

### 4. **Cellavitora (Pflege SA) — Epalinges**
**Website:** [biopole.ch/company/cellavitora](https://www.biopole.ch/company/cellavitora-pflege-biopole/)


Pflege SA is a Swiss-based company founded in 2011, specializing in longevity and anti-aging innovation, with a globally registered brand—Cellavitora—dedicated to enhancing vitality through nature-driven, cell-level care.
 
Inspired by the philosophy "Cell by cell, nature restores," the company has developed a comprehensive range including nutritional supplements that support cellular regeneration, essential oil-based botanical extracts for topical use, and functional foods designed to nourish the body and extend vitality from within.
 A strong nature-meets-science option from within Switzerland's Biopôle biotech hub.

---

### 5. **Nutriop Longevity — Swiss-formulated**
**Website:** [nutriop.com](https://nutriop.com)


Nutriop formulates and tests every batch in Switzerland because they demand the world's highest quality standards, while stocking products in local UK and EU warehouses.
 
Products are Swiss-certified, third-party tested for purity, heavy metals, and potency, and are specifically formulated for absorption, not just digestion.
 A more accessible price point for those wanting Swiss-quality longevity supplements.

---

### 6. **NUTRASWISS — Switzerland**
**Website:** [nutraswiss.in](https://www.nutraswiss.in/)


NUTRASWISS specializes in natural health supplements offering a range of premium vitamins and minerals that are 100% made and packed in Switzerland, and its commitment to quality and innovation has established it as a reputable manufacturer in the nutraceutical industry.
 
NUTRASWISS is a Swiss manufacturer that specializes in premium nutraceutical products, including natural health supplements enriched with vitamins and minerals, with commitment to quality evident in its use of cutting-edge technology and adherence to strict food safety regulations.
 Best for foundational vitamin and mineral longevity stacks.

---

|---|---|
| Most clinical evidence | **Timeline (Amazentis)** |
| Consumer popularity + ETH science | **AVEA Life** |
| Luxury / heritage prestige | **Clinique La Prairie** |
